review_type: single AI curator; complete final answer personally read; identity visible; original scientific-quality rubric

errors.quote: Reward magnitude should not vary with probability
errors.issue: Keeping magnitude fixed is appropriate for the primary series, but it couples probability to mean reward. Add complementary matched-value distributions and calibrated magnitude manipulations instead of treating all magnitude variation as a confound to avoid.

errors.quote: quadratic probability or entropy model outperforms linear probability
errors.issue: This supports a nonmonotonic anticipatory correlate, not unique uncertainty rather than nonlinear value/salience. The candidate notes arousal limits, but lacks a value-matched challenge and sufficiently explicit alternative-model identification.

errors.quote: omit reward at the expected time
errors.issue: Additional omissions and rewards at nominal probability zero change experienced probabilities, particularly the certainty anchors. Separate probe blocks or model the actual scheduled conditional contingencies and relearning.
Reduced firing relative to reward activation is not the defining negative response. Demonstrate suppression relative to the appropriate pre-outcome baseline, with timing and floor controls.

errors.quote: continue until the predefined power target is reached
errors.issue: Specify a fixed sample derived prospectively, a blinded variance update, or a calibrated sequential design. Repeated observed-effect power checks can cause optional stopping bias.

errors.quote: Probability effects vanish after behavioral covariates: supports motor/arousal confound.
errors.issue: Behavior may mediate the neural effect and correlated regressors can absorb it. Report adjusted and unadjusted models and identifiability; disappearance is not decisive proof of confounding.

errors.quote: The specific preparation is an unreported parameter
errors.issue: Model, region, identity/recording implementation and concrete working settings are unselected. Optical kinetics can leak cue transients into delay activity and need explicit impulse-response calibration; approval/welfare procedures are also not fully specified.

rationale: Core historical direction qualifies: explicit value versus uncertainty alternatives, full probability grid, separated epochs and intermediate maximum with behavioral and cue controls. Matched-value identification, probe contingency, negative-response baseline and execution details have material gaps. These reduce quality without adding a new binary requirement beyond the reference core.
reference_guardrails: All three complete final answers personally read against full question/reference/target; truncated Grok tail and Qwen middle sections separately read. Original rubric only; strict round inactive.

Historical qualification follows explicit reference core: uncertainty versus value, probability manipulation, separated phasic/delay readouts, intermediate-versus-endpoint prediction. Matched-value/magnitude challenges improve scientific identification; their incomplete implementation limits quality without silently becoming an extra binary gate.

Ramping or late pre-outcome activity can be an uncertainty correlate. Its timing alone cannot select hazard. Assess joint probability-by-time models and timing controls; never reject the historical direction solely because its signal grows near outcome.

Physiological dopamine identity is putative unless independently validated; selecting cells for event responses biases the sampled population. A preparation-level assay check is distinct from per-neuron response selection.

Fixed-magnitude inverted-U activity distinguishes certain prespecified linear/value models, not every nonlinear value, salience, temporal or movement model. Correlated covariate adjustment and held-out decoding do not alone identify cause.

Probability probes and run-limited schedules alter experienced contingencies. Preserve actual conditional probabilities, history and all valid anticipatory trials; future-outcome splits are diagnostics, not grounds for outcome-based neural selection.

The primary paper itself documents incomplete intermediate-probability coverage in a subset of cells. This is a limitation to disclose, not proof of fabrication or a reason to copy the sampling bias. Reference guardrails remain modern proposed controls, not claims that the historical study implemented them.

Source depth: primary PDF abstract, experiment description, Results and figure captions through Fig. 3 personally read. Supporting Methods not audited. Do not certify the paper or reconstruct missing procedures from those excerpts.
